0022600162.text: The Washington Wizards (3-3, 6th in the East, 1st in the Southeast, on a W1 streak) visit the Orlando Magic (2-4, 9th in the East, 5th in the Southeast and one game back, on an L1 streak) for the Wizards' seventh game of the season, with Orlando 0-3 at home. Washington is missing Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Orlando is without Anthony Black (rest), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Wizards lost 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026.
